model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” for different language families across six models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic,” “IE-Germanic,” “IE-Indic,” “IE-Romance,” “IE-Slavic,” “IE-other,” “Isolate,” “Semitic,” and “Uralic,” displayed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and presents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing the effect for each of the six models, colored green for mBERT-L2, blue for XLM-L2, red for mBERT-R2, brown for XLM-R2, teal for mBERT-B2, and dark red for XLM-B2.  Each bar also has error bars extending from the top and bottom of the bar indicating variability. Representative values for the models within each language family vary; for example, for the “IE-Baltic” family, the mBERT-B2 bar extends to approximately 6 while the mBERT-L2 bar extends to approximately 8. For the “Uralic” family, the XLM-B2 bar extends to approximately 1, whereas the XLM-L2 bar extends to approximately 15. The bars are grouped by language family, and within each group, the models are consistently ordered as listed in the legend. No specific bars are visually emphasized through shading or other methods.
